messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — we're starting a Terraform-based publisher bootstrap to automate AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace onboarding. Need to align on required legal artifacts, IAM roles, and the minimal offer metadata we can ship with the initial MVP.

jason-cloud: +1. Do we want one repo per cloud or a mono repo with a cloud-specific module? my vote: modules (reusable).

sam-legal: FYI I'll need the publisher agreement scan, the company DUNS/Tax ID, and the EULA draft for each marketplace. Can someone confirm who owns collecting those? @maria-partnerships? :thinking_face:

maria-partnerships: I'll gather the EULA + publisher info from sales ops. For DUNS we might need finance to confirm. For immediate bootstrapping, can we proceed with placeholders in Terraform and mark as TODO in docs?

jason-cloud: Yes — we can add a `publisher_metadata.tf` with placeholder variables. Example snippet I mocked:```terraform
provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

module "marketplace_offer" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/marketplace-modules//aws"
  publisher_id = var.publisher_id # TODO: replace
  offer_name   = var.offer_name
}
```

lex-engineering: Heads up — the AWS publisher portal requires the Offer ID and an alias mapping that must match the S3 asset prefix. We'll want a `manifest.json` artifact too. For GCP the vendor portal expects contact email + support URL fields.

sam-legal: Also confirm data residency statements in the listing text — Azure's marketplace compliance team flagged ambiguous wording last time. I'll provide a compliant template language. :white_check_mark:

jason-cloud: Operational question: who will hold the cloud account for listing? we need a publisher account per cloud. If we reuse Redwood's publisher accounts for early customers, we must record entitlements and billing mapping.

maria-partnerships: Plan: Phase 1 (internal sandbox listing) use Redwood org publisher accounts; Phase 2 (customer-handled) we'll automate issuer mapping via Terraform variables and secret rotation. Document will reflect both paths.

deploy-bot: Created ticket: #PLAT-8922 Terraform marketplace bootstrap — assign to jason-cloud. Link: https://phab/redwood/TPLAT-8922

lex-engineering: One more infra note — for Azure offers we need a service principal with Contributor on the Publisher resource and Storage Blob Data Contributor on the assets container. I'll add IAM module to the repo.

jason-cloud: I'll push an initial module under `infra/marketplace/bootstrap` with `variables.tf` and a `README.md` describing required artifacts. Will include a checklist: publisher_id, offer_alias, EULA_pdf, support_url, billing_sku_map.csv.

sam-legal: I can provide the EULA_pdf and compliant listing blurb by EOD Thursday. Also pinging finance for DUNS and tax confirmation.

maria-partnerships: Great — next steps: jason builds skeleton + placeholder TF, lex adds IAM roles, sam supplies legal copy, I'll coordinate finance and customer-facing IDs. Follow-up sync Thursday 10am PT? :calendar:

jason-cloud: Sounds good. I'll open PR with skeleton and the sample `manifest.json` format.

maria-partnerships: Thanks all. If anything blocks collection of legal IDs ping #finance-ops and cc me. Closing thread for now. :v:
